feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events for countering a spell, combat damage to a planeswalker, cards milled from library to graveyard, committing a crime, playing a land, unlocking a Room, an Equipment becoming unattached, lands entering under an opponent's control unplayed, self-cast triggers, and a cause filter on trigger doubling.
Add a repeat-until-predicate reveal/look op (land, basic land, Elf/Elemental, shared card type, hand or battlefield source) with branching destinations and rest to bottom or graveyard.
Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Make power/toughness comparisons (at most, versus a target's power, X-valued), hasKeyword, colorless, same-name and mana-ability leaves usable in target filters, searches and continuous statics.
Add set-base-P/T with Values, all creature types, add Artifact/Zombie/color types without dropping others, set name, remove all abilities, applied to many objects at once.

feature: Trigger source, subject and payload filters
description: Add source/subject filters and defined event payloads (damage source's controller, damage total, creature-only source, equipped creature, dying creature) to damage, ability-activation and death triggers.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add a tapped option to hand and graveyard-to-battlefield ops (handToBattlefield, graveyardToBattlefieldEach, activated return from graveyard).

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add ops granting flashback until end of turn, cast-from-exile with any-mana permission, play permission for exiled cards, airbend, and cast-chosen-exiled-card with rest to bottom.
Model suspend, encore, miracle and warp as alternative casts with exile/time-counter, token-copy and recast riders.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope and chooser fields so each player (or a targeted player) keeps a chosen subset, searches, or draws a per-player count on resolution.

feature: Resolution-time creature type choice for spells
description: Add a choose-a-creature-type step on spell resolution whose result feeds later effects, including per-player choices.
Add set-wide damage prevention (all damage from opponents' creatures, attacking artifacts, permanents with counters), prevent-all-damage-to-self grants and a 'combat damage can't be prevented' rule.

feature: Count of objects affected by the previous effect
description: Add Values and Conditions reading the result of the preceding effect (exiled land this way, nontoken creatures destroyed, damage dealt to opponents, discovered card's mana value, per-target destroyed controller tokens).

Add an optional-action wrapper whose later steps are conditioned on whether the player actually performed it (return a creature, exile from graveyard, optional return after mill, repeated optional search).

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Support up to-one and any-number target slots, including optional slots that exclude an earlier target and return-to-hand ops over counted slots.

Add conditions for a returned land being a Desert, attached state of a Reconfigure source, blocking or blocked by a Goblin or Orc, per-opponent draw and land-entered counts, and per-opponent life lost.

feature: Durations until end of your next turn
description: Add an until-end-of-your-next-turn duration for control changes, keyword grants and play permissions on exiled cards.
Add AbilityCost forms: exile another creature you control, return a Forest or land you control to hand, and the untap symbol {Q}.
Add Values and Conditions reading the power, mana value or supertypes of the permanent sacrificed as a cost.

feature: Another player's optional choice on resolution
description: Add an effect where another player decides or chooses on resolution (opponent splits searched cards, chooses fame or fortune, accepts an optional draw) with per-player branches.
Add target kinds and constraints: spell-or-any-permanent, any-target filtered by creature type, same-controller graveyard card for a second slot, and creatures controlled by different players.
Add return-to-hand delayed to next end step, controller-aware return riders and end-step exile-then-token steps, and bind a put-onto-battlefield creature to haste and delayed sacrifice.
Add rule statics capping attackers per combat, stopping all creatures or an opponent's land from untapping, and extra blocks per creature.
Add a card-type filter to discardCard costs and discard effects (creature card, artifact card) and branch on the discarded card's type.
Add 'you win the game' and 'you lose the game' effects, including at-end-step losses.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add myriad (token copies per opponent, exiled at end of combat) and ripple as grantable keywords.
Add mana abilities counting graveyard cards by characteristic, duplicating whatever a permanent produced, and a game-wide until-end-of-turn mana rider on tapping Swamps.
Add conditions for this-turn history: you attacked, creatures attacked this turn (usable in resolving selectors), life gained.
Add a die-roll effect (d20) whose result feeds draw counts, token counts and reflexive effects.
Add entersAsCopy options: add subtype, name override, legendary, remove other card types, grant activated abilities.
Add toxic and can't-block characteristics to TokenSpec and per-token copy of several different tokens.
Add static alternative or free costs for spells (zero-cost Zombies, once-per-turn {0} cast limited by time counters).
Add static free-cast permission for a spell type (Dragons) and cast-from-exile permission for the card itself.

feature: Static permission to cast spells with flash
description: Add a static rule or effect letting players cast (matching or conditional) spells as though they had flash.

feature: Grant landwalk, horsemanship and afflict keywords
description: Add islandwalk and fear to IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS so addKeyword and static grants work.

feature: Replacement effects redirecting where a card goes
description: Add replacements that shuffle a card into its owner's library instead of going to the graveyard.

feature: Reference to the card moved by the previous effect
description: Let later effects reference the card discarded or exiled by an earlier step (its type, its identity for a free cast).

feature: Cards drawn this turn Value or condition
description: Add a Value and Condition counting cards the player has drawn this turn.

feature: Missing Values for equipment count and mana spent
description: Add Values counting Equipment attached to a creature and the number of colors of mana spent to cast the spell.
Add Value division with round-down (half X, half a library's size).

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Allow a Value (artifacts count, commander casts) instead of a fixed number for look-at-top and copy counts.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Add legendary supertype and color overrides to createTokenCopyOf.

feature: Grant spell keywords to later spells
description: Add effects or statics granting cascade to the next spell cast or to spells cast with Treasure mana or from exile.
Add counter kinds that grant their keyword (reach, deathtouch, flying, lifelink) and keep working when the source loses abilities.
Add a static cost increase for all spells or for artifact and enchantment spells opponents cast.

feature: Extra turns and phases for other players
description: Add extra turn for a target player and an additional beginning phase.
Add a life-gain doubling replacement effect.
Add a draw replacement letting the controller choose land or nonland and reveal down to that kind.

feature: Statics that function from the graveyard
description: Let static effects apply while the source card is in its owner's graveyard.
Let manaValueAtMost/equals take a Value such as the announced X.
Add a Value for the toughness of the trigger object.
Add a replacement that swaps created tokens for a different token instead of only adding extras.

feature: Enter-with-counters rider on blink, reanimation and copy
description: Add conditional enters-with-counters on escape casts.
Add can't-be-blocked-except-by-creatures-with-haste restrictions.
Add a selector for cards sharing a creature type with a creature you control.

feature: Conditions on the triggering object or event player
description: Add a cast-from-exile condition (castFrom only distinguishes graveyard, hand and notHand).
Let copy ops take a Value count (spells cast earlier this turn, commander casts).

feature: Ability and spell copying with source filters
description: Add a pay-mana option to copyActivatedAbility.
